title: ze_surf_dark_fantasy_v2go2
description: A CS:GO map (Source 1, baked from its BSP): the Queen, the ghost of the "Secret - Ghosts" boss arena on the way to the true ending, dancing in the middle and throwing lasers.

scenarios.name: The Queen (ghost)
scenarios.summary: She dances in the middle and throws lasers
scenarios.description: lvls_collector_trig_final -> init_Boss_Arena (bossarena.nut) shuffles ErrorGirl, Queen and CatGirl; the Queen's turn ForceSpawns boss_PT_queen and runs init_Boss() on boss_queen_phbox (bosshp_queen.nut, ported). HP 150 + 500 per human, 1 per bullet. Every 11-16 s Handler_Attack picks one of four: Uganda (60 sprites flung off the spinning boss_queen_rot, 0.16 s apart), Reverse Uganda, Rain from Uganda (from above), or Lasers: 20 boss_attack_PT_laser blades 0.5 s apart from boss_queen_laser_maker (spinning on boss_queen_rot, rolling on boss_queen_rot2), each a trigger_hurt of 100/s (50 a touch) on a door that flies 800 u out at 800 u/s. Touching her: boss_queen_hurt, 80/s. Humans have 100 HP here (stm_tp_human sets it every round; 300 only with the Heal item). Win when her death calls BossDead().
